remaining_cautions.evidence_context: CAMP/dbAMP summary rows match the primary paper MIC sequence/value surface but carry database source/activity labels that are not equivalent to the primary native-ES purification/PTM context; retained as source_conflict rows.
Primary paper reports both MASCOT TPFLLVGTQIDLR and a PEAKS PTM-bearing variant; database matching uses the unmodified MASCOT sequence while preserving the modification caveat.

Local supplementary .bin assets were opened/classified as HTML captures; no local spreadsheet, office document, or PDF supplement supplied additional activity values beyond XML/PDF Table 1 and results text.
Mechanism claims are source-reviewed qualitatively from text and figure captions; exact graph/histogram values were not fabricated.
